description: This is a shell script that manages the start, stop, and restart of a multicast proxy service ('mcastproxy'), including configuration generation based on system interfaces and statuses. It contains setup, control logic, and command executions specific to the multicast proxy service.

methods.name: do_start_igmpproxy
methods.description: Starts the igmpproxy service by generating configuration files based on current interface status and system properties, then executing the appropriate proxy binary.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes system variables and environment by reading system properties, interface statuses, and preparing variables for the service control functions.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Begins the multicast proxy service if WAN interface is available and enabled, calling the configuration setup and updating system event states.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the multicast proxy service, killing the proxy process and cleaning up configuration files, and updates system event states.
